title: Eventual overlap compatibility for fixed local module models
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor with Noetherian rings $R_k$, and $c$ a limit cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ with affine vertex $S$. Fix $i\in I$ and a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Put $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}S$ and $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ for $j\geq i$ [def-pc-base-change]. Fix $j\geq i$ and a finite affine open cover $U_a\to X_j$. Suppose finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $N_a$ on $U_a$ [pqf-def-coherent] and a module $M$ on $X$ are given, together with component isomorphisms from the pullbacks of $N_a$ to the restrictions of $M$ on the pulled-back cover. Then there is $k\geq j$ such that the cover $V=U\times_{X_j}X_k$ carries descent data $D$. Each $D_a$ is isomorphic to the pullback of the prescribed $N_a$ to $V_a$. Moreover there is a morphism $\eta$ from the pullback of $D$ to the restriction descent datum of $M$ on the pulled-back $V$, and every component of $\eta$ is invertible. No global module is constructed, no local objects are descended, and no finite-presentation or quasi-coherence conclusion about $D_a$ is asserted. The supplied isomorphisms need not be compatible initially; their conjugates prescribe the overlap identifications to be lifted.

proof.text: Apply overlap map lifting to the fixed local models and their specified limit isomorphisms. Obtain a stage k and natural overlap transitions T, local object isomorphisms, and an invertible limit component comparison, without asserting finite-stage identity or cocycle equations.
Apply eventual coherence to these specific transitions. Obtain l≥k where their canonical pullback T′ is coherent, and its limit component comparison still commutes with the transitions.

Build D from T′ by filling the DescentData fields with its objects, maps, naturality, identity, and composition proofs. Pull the local object isomorphisms along the canonical refinement chart maps and compose with pullbackCompOfEq to identify D_a with the direct pullback of the original N_a. Build eta with the homs of the limit component comparison; its commutation field is exactly the comparison equation. Every component is an isomorphism because it is the hom of the supplied component iso. Choose the final bound hjk.trans hkl.
